2115942348794298562.en_summary: Criticizes Josh Brown's bullish and simplistic views on technology earnings and stock prices, quoting his comments that earnings expectations for tech are going higher, there is an anti-bubble in technology, and Amazon $AMZN earnings could be explosive. Notes Josh recently recommended $RDDT which fell from $106 after hours by 21% or $28, and about $100 over ten weeks, with no contrition or pushback on CNBC.
